SAFETY NOTICE – WAREHOUSE

All warehouse personnel must wear protective helmets and safety shoes [1] entering the loading area. [2] Forklifts have the right of way at all times, so pedestrians should [3] aside when a vehicle approaches. Any accident, however minor, must be reported to a supervisor [4]. Failure to follow these rules may result in disciplinary action.

questions.explanation: 'Before entering' sets the equipment as a prerequisite to entering the area.

choices: The company picnic will be held in July.
Lunch is served in the cafeteria from noon.
Please submit vacation requests two weeks in advance.
Visitors must be accompanied by an employee at all times.
questions.explanation: The sentence is a safety rule for the area and precedes another safety rule.
After 'should', the base form of the verb is used.
An adverb is needed to modify the verb 'reported'.

Students who have unpaid fees will not be able to register [4] they settle their accounts at the bursar's office.

Registrar's Office

questions.explanation: A scheduled future event uses the present simple, third-person singular.

choices: You can view the full list of available courses on the same page.
The football season ends next week.
New parking rules take effect on Monday.
Graduation photos can be ordered online.
questions.explanation: The sentence explains how to choose courses and precedes the warning about full courses.
'Early' is used as an adverb to modify 'register'.
Registration is blocked up to the moment the accounts are settled.

text:
Luxury Living at Riverside Towers

Discover a new standard of comfort in the heart of downtown. Each apartment features floor-to-ceiling windows, a fully equipped kitchen, and a private balcony [1] stunning views of the river. [2] Residents also enjoy a fitness center, a rooftop garden, and 24-hour security. Units are [3] for immediate occupancy. Call 555-0193 today to schedule a [4].

questions.explanation: A present participle introduces what the balcony provides.

choices: Our company was founded by two engineers.
Bus fares will increase next month.
The building is within walking distance of shops, restaurants, and the central train station.
Please submit all complaints in writing.
questions.explanation: The sentence describes the location; the next one begins with 'Residents also enjoy', adding more advantages.
Units that can be occupied immediately are 'available'.
A noun is needed after 'a': to schedule a viewing means to arrange a visit.

text:
Dear Mr. Lindgren,

Following your recent interviews, we are pleased to offer you the position of Operations Analyst at Delta Logistics. Your annual salary will be $62,000, [1] you will also be eligible for a yearly bonus. [2] Your start date will be Monday, February 2. Please confirm your acceptance by signing and returning the enclosed contract [3] January 20. We are confident that you will be a valuable [4] to our team.

Sincerely,
Annette Moore

questions.explanation: The bonus is an addition to the salary, so the clauses are joined by 'and'.

choices: We have recently opened a new warehouse in Dallas.
The company picnic takes place every July.
Benefits include health insurance and twenty days of paid leave.
Our delivery trucks are inspected every month.
questions.explanation: The sentence continues the description of the offer and precedes the start date.
'By' marks the deadline for the reply.
A noun is needed after 'a valuable': 'a valuable addition to the team'.

★★★★★ Excellent value

I bought the Atlas 15 laptop two months ago, and I am extremely [1] with it. The battery lasts about ten hours, [2] is more than enough for a full day of meetings. [3] The screen is bright and sharp, and the keyboard is comfortable. The only [4] is that the speakers are a little weak. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable work computer.

questions.explanation: People are 'satisfied with' a product.
'Which' refers back to the whole preceding clause.

choices: I returned it to the store the next day.
It is also lighter than my previous model.
The store was closed when I arrived.
I have not had time to open the box.
questions.explanation: The review is positive; the sentence adds another advantage, like the one that follows.
A 'drawback' is a disadvantage, which fits the weak speakers.

text:
PARKING NOTICE

Effective Monday, June 2, the Central Plaza parking garage will [1] a new payment system. Drivers will no longer be able to pay by cash. [2] Instead, payment will be accepted by card or through the Parkly mobile app. Monthly pass holders should [3] their old passes at the management office before May 30 [4] a replacement.

questions.explanation: A system is 'implemented', meaning put into operation.

choices: Ticket machines will be removed from all exits.
Visitors may park free for the first thirty minutes.
The garage is closed on public holidays.
Parking fines will be reviewed next year.
questions.explanation: The next sentence begins with 'Instead', so the previous one must describe the removal of the old way of paying.
Pass holders 'exchange' an old pass for a new one.
An infinitive of purpose is needed: 'to receive a replacement'.

Dear Members,

You are cordially invited to the Chamber of Commerce Annual Gala, which will take place on Saturday, November 15, at the Grand Plaza Hotel. [1] The evening will begin with a reception at 6 p.m., [2] by dinner and an awards ceremony. Business attire is [3]. To reserve your table, please reply [4] November 1.

choices: The hotel's parking garage is closed for repairs.
Membership fees are due at the end of the year.
Our office will move to a new address next month.
This year's event will honor local entrepreneurs who have created new jobs.
questions.explanation: The sentence tells what the gala is about, before the program is given.
'Followed by' describes the order of events.
The passive adjective 'requested' fits the dress code.
'By' introduces the deadline for replying.

text:
MEMO
To: Sales team
From: Regional Director
Subject: Third-quarter results

I am delighted to report that our region exceeded its sales target by 12 percent in the third quarter. [1] This result was [2] largely to the new customer loyalty program. Each of you contributed to this success. To [3] our momentum, we will hold a training session on October 8 [4] the new products.

choices: Revenue from online orders more than doubled compared with last year.
Please return your company laptops by Friday.
The cafeteria will serve breakfast starting Monday.
The office will be painted this weekend.
questions.explanation: The sentence gives a detail about the good result, which 'This result' then refers to.
'Due to' means 'caused by'; 'was due largely to' is correct.
One 'maintains' momentum, meaning keeps it going.
A present participle introduces the content of the session.
